# HexaLoam

> HexaLoam (by HexaLoam contributors) is a modifiable 3D-printable 18-DOF modular hexapod robot platform with an RP-Lidar reference mount, M3 nut pockets, an open controller/battery bay, editable SOLIDWORKS CAD, STL/3MF printables, MATLAB Simscape Multibody XML/STEP export, and Unity/Unreal GLB visual meshes.

HexaLoam is a mechanical and simulation starting point for agriculture, inspection, mapping (LiDAR/LOAM), education, and robotics research. Builders choose and integrate their own actuators, fasteners, controller, battery, wiring, firmware, and navigation software. Physical walking performance and field trials remain to be measured. The repository has no blanket open-source license; see CONTRIBUTING.md for reuse and contribution terms.

## Core Pages

- [HexaLoam Homepage](https://equesai.github.io/HexaLoam/): Overview, hardware specifications, interactive gait viewer, MATLAB Simscape summary, FAQ, and citation metadata.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam): Source CAD assemblies, printable STLs/3MF, GLB meshes, MATLAB examples, Python rendering tools, and documentation.
- [Walking Gait Videos Hub](https://equesai.github.io/HexaLoam/videos/): Side-by-side comparison of Tripod, Ripple, and Wave gaits (60 mm stride, 12 mm/s, 22 mm peak foot clearance, 10 s / 2 cycles, 50 mm grid).
- [Tripod Gait Video](https://equesai.github.io/HexaLoam/videos/tripod/): 3 feet in stance; alternating groups of 3 legs ([YouTube Short](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/4rD9bK5iIl8)).
- [Ripple Gait Video](https://equesai.github.io/HexaLoam/videos/ripple/): 4 feet in stance; staggered overlapping foot swings ([YouTube Short](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ggAerDmc-yU)).
- [Wave Gait Video](https://equesai.github.io/HexaLoam/videos/wave/): 5 feet in stance; sequential rear-to-front single-foot swing ([YouTube Short](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/ZopVjcM9axM)).

## CAD & 3D-Printable Hardware

- [Main SOLIDWORKS Assembly (`Full_Robot_Assembly.SLDASM`)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/Full_Robot_Assembly.SLDASM): Complete 57-instance robot assembly with MG996R servo and RP-Lidar reference models.
- [Single-Leg Subassembly (`LegMates.SLDASM`)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/LegMates.SLDASM): Inspect one three-joint hexapod leg linkage.
- [Editable SOLIDWORKS Parts (`Designed/`)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/tree/main/Designed): `Robot_Base.SLDPRT`, `L1.SLDPRT`, `L2.SLDPRT`, `L3.SLDPRT`, and `LidarCover.SLDPRT`.
- [Reference Hardware (`Common/`)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/tree/main/Common): MG996R servo, RP-Lidar, and 18650 battery CAD references.
- [Bambu Studio Project (`Printables/Full_Robot.3mf`)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/Printables/Full_Robot.3mf): Six-plate layout configured for a Bambu Lab X1 Carbon 0.4 mm nozzle profile.
- [Printable STL Files (`Printables/`)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/tree/main/Printables): Five watertight STL designs making 20 printed pieces (`Robot_Base.STL` x1: 203.5 x 68.0 x 208.9 mm; `L1.STL` x6: 119.9 x 123.0 x 120.0 mm; `L2.STL` x6: 158.6 x 64.8 x 39.4 mm; `L3.STL` x6: 246.2 x 50.0 x 120.0 mm; `LidarCover.STL` x1: 111.3 x 63.0 x 77.5 mm). Central bay includes mounting holes and M3 nut pockets.

## Simulation & Visual Meshes

- [Simscape Multibody CAD Export (`Full_Robot_Assembly.xml`)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/simulation/cad-export/Full_Robot_Assembly.xml): Assembly XML plus 7 STEP files in `simulation/cad-export/`, imported and compiled in MATLAB R2025b with 18 revolute joints and 29 additional 6-DOF joints requiring mechanical review.
- [Single-Leg Static Study (`simulation/matlab/legStaticStudy.m`)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/simulation/matlab/legStaticStudy.m): Idealized yaw-pitch-pitch static Jacobian and holding-torque MATLAB study (e.g. 5 N tip load at 0.25 m gives 0, 1.10, and 0.60 N·m) with unit test `testLegStaticStudy.m`.
- [Static GLB Visual Meshes (`simulation/meshes/`)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/tree/main/simulation/meshes): Meter-scaled GLB parts (`Robot_Base.glb`, `L1.glb`, `L2.glb`, `L3.glb`, `LidarCover.glb`) verified in Blender 4.2.16 LTS, documented for Unity glTFast and Unreal Engine 5.3, with SHA-256 `manifest.json`.

## Documentation

- [README.md](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/README.md): Platform overview, hardware dimensions, printing instructions, and quick links.
- [Designer Guide](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/docs/designer-guide.md): Adapting the M3 mounting pattern, controller/battery bay, payload clearances, and example setups.
- [Walking Sequences](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/docs/walking.md): Tripod, ripple, and wave kinematic animations and Python/VTK reproduction commands.
- [Simulation Guide](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/docs/simulation-guide.md): Blender, Unity, Unreal Engine, MATLAB single-leg study, and Simscape Multibody import details.
- [CAD Gallery](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/docs/gallery.md): Multi-angle renders, 360-degree turntable, and distal joint sweep study.
- [Development Roadmap](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/docs/development-roadmap.md): Eight-milestone engineering roadmap and acceptance tests.
- [Citation Metadata (`CITATION.cff`)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/CITATION.cff): Citation metadata (frozen mechanical design commit `9ff03f0c9c558f973bb2e2860629756cdab8acc8`).
- [Contribution Guide (`CONTRIBUTING.md`)](https://github.com/equesai/HexaLoam/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Evidence requirements and reuse terms.
